text:
alex: heads-up — PR #4829 is green except for two style/lint complaints from the CI run. small whitespace + a rename in pkg/http. can someone grab these before the merge window closes today?

ci-bot: build/4829 — failed checks: gofmt, golangci-lint (2 issues). Logs: https://ci.redwood/4829/logs

maya: I can take the whitespace one (easy). which file is the rename?

alex: thanks — whitespace is in cmd/serve/main.go (trailing spaces + one blank line). rename is in pkg/http/handler.go: `reqID` -> `requestID` to match other packages. small but touches a few callers.

sam: I can handle the rename, but heads-up — one unit test references reqID in testutils and will need updating. shouldn't be hard.

maya: quick question — are we using gofumpt or gofmt rules here? CI flagged gofmt but locally I run gofumpt, might reorder imports.

alex: CI runs gofmt (vanilla). gofumpt is fine but avoid auto-import reorder that CI would treat as formatting diff.

jen: if you're touching handler.go, can you also make the exported comment on Handler consistent? small docstring nit I noticed. happy to squash into the same commit.

sam: ok I'll do rename + test fix + docstring. plan: create branch fix/4829-rename, push, request re-run.

sam: (after a few minutes) pushed: branch fix/4829-rename -> PR updated. diff is small: 6 files changed, mostly rename and tests.

ci-bot: build/4829 (re-run) — checks started.

jen: nice. maya, you still good to do the whitespace fix?

maya: yes, will push that in a separate commit on same PR to keep history clear.

ci-bot: build/4829 — golangci-lint passed. gofmt failed: cmd/serve/main.go: trailing whitespace lines: 12, 45.

maya: fixed and pushed. removed trailing spaces, trimmed one extra blank line.

ci-bot: build/4829 — all checks passed ✅

alex: lovely — thanks all. sam/jen do you want me to merge once the branch protection checks are green and you have LGTM?

sam: leaving one LGTM on branch after a quick test run locally. all good.

jen: gave LGTM. alex go ahead and merge in the next 30m if the scheduler window is free.

alex: will merge in 20m. noting for the release notes: tiny eslint/gofmt fixes, rename reqID->requestID (internal). no user-facing behavior changes.

maya: :thumbsup: thanks team!

sam: quick follow-up: I'll add a tiny test coverage note in the PR description to explain the test import change.

alex: great. closing thread after merge.
